sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect personal information you voluntarily provide, including name, email, phone number, and health-related information necessary for therapy. We also collect usage data through analytics.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your information is used solely to provide therapy services, schedule appointments, and improve our services. We do not sell or share personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information. All session notes and health records are stored securely and accessible only to authorized clinicians.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. You may also withdraw consent for data processing. Contact us to exercise these rights.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.content: For privacy-related queries, contact us at mindscaping.in@gmail.com or call +91 88799 97299.
